name: move steps
does: Moves the sprite forward by a number of steps, in the direction it faces.

name: turn clockwise
does: Turns the sprite clockwise by a number of degrees.

name: turn counterclockwise
does: Turns the sprite counterclockwise by a number of degrees.

name: go to a target
does: Jumps to a random position, the mouse pointer or another sprite.

name: go to x and y
does: Jumps to an exact place given by x and y.

name: glide to a target
does: Moves smoothly over some seconds to a random position, the mouse pointer or a sprite.

name: glide to x and y
does: Moves smoothly over some seconds to an exact place.

name: point in direction
does: Faces the sprite in a direction in degrees: 90 is right, -90 left, 0 up, 180 down.

name: point towards
does: Faces the sprite towards the mouse pointer or another sprite.

name: change x
does: Moves the sprite sideways by an amount.

name: set x
does: Puts the sprite at a sideways position.

name: change y
does: Moves the sprite up or down by an amount.

name: set y
does: Puts the sprite at an up and down position.

name: if on edge, bounce
does: Turns the sprite back if it touches the edge of the stage.

name: set rotation style
does: Chooses whether the sprite flips, spins all around or does not rotate when it turns.

name: x position
does: The sprite's sideways position, as a value.

name: y position
does: The sprite's up and down position, as a value.

name: direction
does: The direction the sprite faces, as a value.

name: say for some seconds
does: Shows words in a speech bubble for a number of seconds.

name: say
does: Shows words in a speech bubble until changed.

name: think for some seconds
does: Shows words in a thought bubble for a number of seconds.

name: think
does: Shows words in a thought bubble until changed.

name: switch costume
does: Changes how the sprite looks, to a named costume.

name: next costume
does: Changes to the sprite's next costume. Used to animate.

name: change size
does: Makes the sprite bigger or smaller by an amount.

name: set size
does: Sets the sprite's size as a percentage.

name: show
does: Makes the sprite visible.

name: hide
does: Makes the sprite invisible.

name: go to front or back layer
does: Puts the sprite in front of or behind all the others.

name: go forward or backward layers
does: Moves the sprite some layers forward or back.

name: costume number or name
does: The current costume, as a value.

name: size
does: The sprite's size, as a value.

name: when this sprite clicked
does: Starts a script when the sprite is clicked.

name: when I start as a clone
does: Starts a script in each new copy of the sprite.

name: delete this clone
does: Removes the copy that is running this script.

name: touching a target
does: True while the sprite touches the mouse pointer, the edge or another sprite.

name: touching a colour
does: True while the sprite touches a colour.

name: colour touching colour
does: True while one colour of the sprite touches another colour.

name: distance to
does: How far the sprite is from the mouse pointer or a sprite, as a value.

name: set drag mode
does: Chooses whether the sprite can be dragged while the project runs.

name: switch backdrop
does: Changes the stage background.

name: switch backdrop and wait
does: Changes the background and waits for the scripts it starts.

name: next backdrop
does: Changes to the next background.

name: change graphic effect
does: Changes an effect such as ghost, colour or whirl by an amount.

name: set graphic effect
does: Sets an effect such as ghost, colour or whirl to a value.

name: clear graphic effects
does: Removes all graphic effects.

name: backdrop number or name
does: The current background, as a value.

name: play sound until done
does: Plays a sound and waits for it to finish.

name: start sound
does: Starts a sound and carries straight on.

name: stop all sounds
does: Stops every sound.

name: change sound effect
does: Changes pitch or left and right balance by an amount.

name: set sound effect
does: Sets pitch or left and right balance.

name: clear sound effects
does: Removes all sound effects.

name: change volume
does: Makes sounds louder or quieter by an amount.

name: set volume
does: Sets how loud sounds are, as a percentage.

name: volume
does: The current volume, as a value.

name: when green flag clicked
does: Starts a script when the project is run.

name: when key pressed
does: Starts a script when a keyboard key is pressed.

name: when stage clicked
does: Starts a script when the stage is clicked.

name: when backdrop switches to
does: Starts a script when the background changes to a named one.

name: when loudness or timer is greater than
does: Starts a script when the microphone loudness or the timer passes a number.

name: when I receive a message
does: Starts a script when a message is broadcast.

name: broadcast a message
does: Sends a message that other scripts can react to.

name: broadcast and wait
does: Sends a message and waits for the scripts it starts to finish.

name: wait
does: Pauses the script for a number of seconds.

name: repeat
does: Runs the blocks inside a set number of times.

name: forever
does: Runs the blocks inside again and again without stopping.

name: if then
does: Runs the blocks inside only when a condition is true.

name: if then else
does: Runs one part when a condition is true and another when it is false.

name: wait until
does: Pauses the script until a condition becomes true.

name: repeat until
does: Runs the blocks inside again and again until a condition is true.

name: stop
does: Stops all scripts, this script, or the other scripts of the sprite.

name: create clone of
does: Makes a copy of a sprite while the project runs.

name: ask and wait
does: Asks a question and waits for a typed answer.

name: answer
does: What was typed after the last question, as a value.

name: key pressed
does: True while a keyboard key is held.

name: mouse down
does: True while the mouse button is held.

name: mouse x
does: The pointer's sideways position, as a value.

name: mouse y
does: The pointer's up and down position, as a value.

name: loudness
does: How loud the microphone hears, as a value.

name: timer
does: Seconds since the timer was reset, as a value.

name: reset timer
does: Sets the timer back to zero.

name: property of
does: A value belonging to another sprite or the stage, such as its position.

name: current date or time
does: The current year, month, day or time, as a value.

name: days since 2000
does: The number of days since the year 2000, as a value.

name: online
does: True when the computer is online.

name: username
does: The signed in user's name, as a value.

name: add
does: Adds two numbers.

name: subtract
does: Takes one number from another.

name: multiply
does: Multiplies two numbers.

name: divide
does: Divides one number by another.

name: pick random number
does: A random number between two numbers.

name: greater than
does: True when the first value is bigger than the second.

name: less than
does: True when the first value is smaller than the second.

name: equals
does: True when two values are the same.

name: and
does: True when both conditions are true.

name: or
does: True when either condition is true.

name: not
does: True when a condition is false.

name: join text
does: Puts two pieces of text together.

name: letter of
does: One letter from some text.

name: length of text
does: How many letters some text has.

name: text contains
does: True when some text includes other text.

name: remainder
does: What is left over after dividing.

name: round
does: The nearest whole number.

name: maths function
does: A function such as square root, absolute value, floor or sine.

name: variable value
does: The value stored in a variable.

name: set variable
does: Stores a value in a variable.

name: change variable
does: Adds to a variable, or takes away with a negative number.

name: show variable
does: Shows a variable on the stage.

name: hide variable
does: Hides a variable from the stage.

name: list contents
does: Everything in a list, as a value.

name: add to list
does: Puts an item at the end of a list.

name: delete item of list
does: Removes an item from a list.

name: delete all of list
does: Empties a list.

name: insert into list
does: Puts an item at a position in a list.

name: replace item of list
does: Changes the item at a position in a list.

name: item of list
does: The item at a position in a list.

name: position of item in list
does: Where an item is in a list.

name: length of list
does: How many items a list has.

name: list contains
does: True when a list includes an item.

name: show list
does: Shows a list on the stage.

name: hide list
does: Hides a list from the stage.
